notes: The text says: one pot pin to 5V, centre pin to A0, last pin to ground. The pot's outer pins are interchangeable, so I put VCC on 5V and GND on ground.
The image shows the red and black wires going round to the breadboard's bottom power rails. I wired them straight to the pot's columns instead. That gives the same electrical result.
Pot column numbers (15-17, top half, row e) are my choice, since the image doesn't give exact holes. The wires use row a of the same columns.
Ground goes to uno GND.1. The image shows a GND pin on the power header, and any Uno GND pin is the same node.
The schematic image did not load, so the circuit image and the text are the authority.
